استخففت (form X)
# اِسْتَخْفَفْتُ (istaḵfaftu) /is.tax.faf.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَخَفَّ (istaḵaffa)
# اِسْتَخْفَفْتَ (istaḵfafta) /is.tax.faf.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَخَفَّ (istaḵaffa)
# اِسْتَخْفَفْتِ (istaḵfafti) /is.tax.faf.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَخَفَّ (istaḵaffa)
# اُسْتُخْفِفْتُ (ustuḵfiftu) /us.tux.
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
